sourceVisualNotes: Six actual inventory icons viewed;4258 visibly uses red berries and green leaves despite its historical name. Source lore/stats not implemented as new mechanics; all new inner motifs original.

items.name: dusk-violet-horn-coronet
items.designBrief: One compact purple/charcoal arch-shaped crown with a tall central curved golden twin-horn crest, smaller gold triangular brow points and upturned purple side fins. Broad warmgold forehead fitting with small amber gem. Empty lower opening, no skull/face/wearer.

items.name: violet-twin-horn-band
items.designBrief: One matching pair of inward-curving deepviolet/magenta ribbed HORNS joined by a small jade/gold headband base. Rounded segmented keratin with ivory tip bands, small jade beads. Omit source green fire/background aura, no creature head.

items.name: cloud-chocolate-cone
items.designBrief: One small chocolate soft-serve ICE-CREAM in a golden-brown wafer cone, TWO neat ivory cream bands between dark chocolate swirls, tiny jadeleaf and fine warmgold sleeve cloud engraving. Fully visible cone tip, no brand/wrapper text.

items.name: crimson-berry-leaf-clip
items.designBrief: One compact hairclip of FOUR glossy vermilion berries at center and FOUR broad freshjade leaves fanned diagonally around them, fine warmgold veins/fittings. Follow actual berry/leaf icon, not a maple leaf guessed from name, no blood or face.

items.name: ivory-vermilion-star-coronet
items.designBrief: One complete princess ceremonial crown in ivory and vermilion with tall central pointed ivory crest, TWO broad uplifted side wings, warmgold outline and small redjade jewels, short redsilk ties at sides. Lower faceopening transparent, rounded Daoistcloud carving, no wearer.

items.name: black-ivory-silk-bow
items.designBrief: One elegant BLACK-and-IVORY velvet/satin BOW hair ornament, TWO plump black loops with white inner bands, small center jade/gold clasp and two SHORT tapered ribbon tails. Fine handpainted fabric folds, no dots/brands/face.
